category_title: Enthusiastic students who misinterpret geological features based on visual similarities to everyday objects
scenario_title: Unguided fossil observation and visual misidentification
minimal_context: The student is observing a handpicked set of fossils during a small-group activity to practice identification.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please take a look at this handpicked set of fossils and make some observations.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Enthusiastically sorting through the fossil collection) I think I found a ﬁsh.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: ’Cause it has the ﬁn right there and it looks like it has the eye.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Show me exactly what you are looking at on the rock.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Interpreting the entire rock as a fish fossil) See, this striation formed on the rock is the fin, and this indentation in the rock is the eye!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please take a look at this handpicked set of fossils and make some observations.

STUDENT: (Enthusiastically sorting through the fossil collection) I think I found a ﬁsh.

TUTOR: Why do you think that?

STUDENT: ’Cause it has the ﬁn right there and it looks like it has the eye.

TUTOR: Show me exactly what you are looking at on the rock.

STUDENT: (Interpreting the entire rock as a fish fossil) See, this striation formed on the rock is the fin, and this indentation in the rock is the eye!

task.content: Unguided 'discovery' with fossils... making fossil observations and inferences using a handpicked set of fossils
task.learning_goal: practice identification before the actual research samples arrived

context.materials: fossil collection, handpicked set of fossils, rock with striation and an indentation
context.social_setting: small-group activity with the teacher and researcher
context.time_context: second day of making fossil observations

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When observing a rock with striation and an indentation during unguided discovery
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: interpreted the entire rock as a ﬁsh fossil... provided rationale for his thinking by pointing to striation formed on the rock, which he thought was a ﬁn
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: demonstrated little subject-matter knowledge about the fossils he was observing
related_quotes: I think I found a ﬁsh.
’Cause it has the ﬁn right there and it looks like it has the eye.

behavior_patterns.condition: When sorting through the fossil collection
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: enthusiastically began sorting through the fossil collection, making inferences about what he was seeing

behavior_patterns.condition: When asked to provide rationale for his thinking
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: pointing to striation formed on the rock, which he thought was a ﬁn. Moreover, what he thought was an eye was actually an indentation in the rock
related_quotes: ’Cause it has the ﬁn right there and it looks like it has the eye.
